image_description: A side-front view of a compact minibus parked on an asphalt road. The vehicle has a two-tone paint scheme: white on the upper half and purple/blue on the lower half, with a pinkish front bumper area. It features a row of rectangular passenger windows along the side, a large windshield, and a visible sliding door track. The wheels appear to be steel rims painted red. There is some text on the side panel that appears slightly distorted or illegible. Trees and another vehicle are visible in the background.
